_comment: Source of truth for continent placement AND world scale. Corrected 2026-08-10 (2nd pass): world units are now explicitly meters -- the first pass had elevation in real meters but horizontal distance in an undefined 'world unit', which is an inconsistent scale that would have needed a full rescale once brought into the game engine. 8192m (8.2km) per continent was also unrealistically small once rendered at true 1:1 scale -- Corvento's ~2400m peak inside an 8.2km-wide continent is a slope steeper than any real mountain range. Quadrupled to keep elevation relief proportioned like real terrain and to give 8 zone bands per continent room to actually feel large. See docs/01 §5.

bruma.name: The Bruma
bruma.notes: Mysterious central waters of the Luna Sea -- storm-prone, magically anomalous, avoided by ordinary sailors. Midpoint of the sea gap between Valora's east coast and Seradia's west coast.
